This is a sourcing-focused role for someone who enjoys discovering high-quality talent, exploring niche creative communities, and connecting outstanding professionals with exciting career and project opportunities.You will focus on sourcing talent across disciplines such as graphic design, motion design, UX/UI, copywriting, video production, and other creative fields for both full-time and freelance or contractual opportunities. The role requires a sharp eye for creative quality, strong research capabilities, compelling outreach skills, and the ability to build and maintain a reliable pipeline of relevant candidates.This is an opportunity to work in a remote-first, fast-growing environment where your sourcing efforts directly contribute to delivering creative talent for leading brands and businesses.RequirementsRoles and Responsibilities1. Talent Sourcing and IdentificationProactively identify and source high-quality creative professionals across graphic design, motion graphics, UX/UI design, copywriting, video production, and related creative disciplines.Develop effective sourcing strategies to identify suitable candidates for full-time, freelance, and contractual positions.Explore multiple talent discovery platforms, including LinkedIn, Behance, Dribbble, Instagram, professional communities, portfolio websites, and relevant online networks.Identify passive candidates who may not be actively seeking opportunities but possess the skills and portfolios required by hiring clients.Build a diverse and readily accessible talent pool to support a wide range of creative hiring requirements.Experiment with search techniques, Boolean searches, keywords, and alternative sourcing channels to improve candidate discovery.2. Candidate Screening and AssessmentReview candidate profiles and portfolios to assess creative quality, relevant experience, technical capabilities, and alignment with role requirements.Conduct preliminary screening and qualification discussions to understand candidate interests, availability, preferences, and suitability.Evaluate portfolios critically and identify professionals whose work aligns with client expectations and project objectives.Maintain clear communication with candidates throughout the sourcing process, ensuring a professional and positive candidate experience.Share qualified profiles with the recruitment or hiring team, along with relevant observations and portfolio highlights.3. Talent Pipeline and Database ManagementBuild, maintain, and regularly update a structured database of creative professionals across different disciplines and experience levels.Track candidate sourcing activity, outreach status, responses, screening outcomes, availability, and pipeline progress.Maintain an organized talent pipeline to support both immediate hiring needs and anticipated future requirements.Ensure candidate records are accurate, accessible, and consistently updated.Monitor sourcing metrics, identify gaps in pipeline coverage, and provide regular updates on progress and outcomes.4. Sourcing Strategy and Continuous ImprovementAnalyze the effectiveness of sourcing channels, outreach methods, and search strategies.Refine sourcing approaches based on response rates, candidate quality, hiring priorities, and pipeline conversion.Stay informed about emerging creative talent communities, portfolio platforms, and industry trends.Collaborate with recruitment and hiring teams to clarify requirements and improve the quality and speed of sourcing delivery.Manage multiple sourcing assignments simultaneously while maintaining attention to detail and meeting agreed timelines.Must-Have SkillsTalent Sourcing: Ability to proactively identify, research, engage, and pipeline qualified candidates using multiple sourcing channels.Recruitment: Basic understanding of recruitment workflows, candidate screening, and talent pipeline management.Creative Industry Sourcing: Ability to discover and assess creative professionals across design, video, content, and related disciplines.A strong eye for creative quality and the ability to evaluate portfolios against role requirements.Strong written communication skills for personalized candidate outreach and follow-ups.Excellent research, organizational, and time-management skills.Ability to manage multiple sourcing pipelines and maintain accurate candidate records.A proactive, data-driven approach to sourcing and problem-solving.Good-to-Have SkillsTalent Acquisition: Familiarity with end-to-end recruitment processes and coordination with hiring teams.Hiring: Exposure to candidate qualification, interview coordination, and recruitment delivery.Niche Talent Acquisition: Experience sourcing specialized or hard-to-find talent in creative, design, marketing, or digital fields.Experience sourcing freelancers and professionals for contractual or project-based assignments.Familiarity with Boolean search, applicant tracking systems (ATS), recruitment tools, and talent databases.Knowledge of creative portfolio platforms such as Behance and Dribbble, along with professional and social networking channels.Experience and QualificationsAt least 6 months of experience in talent sourcing or recruitment.Experience sourcing candidates in creative, design, marketing, advertising, or digital industries is preferred.Exposure to hiring for both full-time and freelance or contractual roles is jobs.title: Associate Talent Acquisition Partner, Tech
jobs.description: <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote, US </p> <p><strong>Description</strong></p> <p>Keeper is hiring a motivated Associate Talent Acquisition Partner to support the full cycle recruiting process. This is a 100% remote position from select locations with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the Chicago, IL metro area.&nbsp;</p> <p>Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and be responsible for a variety of recruiting support activities from reviewing applications, to sourcing candidates and facilitating new hire on-boarding logistics.</p> <p><strong>About Keeper</strong></p> <p>Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at<a href="http://keepersecurity.com"> KeeperSecurity.com</a>.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>We're looking for a sharp, detail-oriented recruiting professional who is comfortable taking initiative and managing multiple priorities. The Associate Talent Acquisition Partner will support the Talent Acquisition team across a variety of roles while independently managing select junior and support-level searches. This is a great opportunity for someone with foundational recruiting experience who is looking to grow their full-cycle recruiting and sourcing skills in a fast-paced SaaS environment.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the full-cycle recruitment process by reviewing applications, corresponding with candidates and hiring managers, coordinating interviews, sourcing candidates and supporting new hire onboarding activities</li> <li>Review applications and advance candidates who meet minimum qualifications</li> <li>Source candidates using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing platforms</li> <li>Facilitate candidate and hiring manager communications and provide timely status updates throughout the interview process</li> <li>Manage full-cycle recruiting for assigned junior, support and other lower-complexity roles, including conducting screening interviews</li> <li>Launch assessments, monitor progress and manage associated communications</li> <li>Partner with HR and training teams to coordinate pre-employment screening and new hire onboarding activities</li> <li>Create and update process documentation, communication templates and recruitment reporting</li> <li>Maintain accurate candidate and requisition information within the applicant tracking system</li> <li>Support special projects for the Talent Acquisition and Human Resources teams</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>1–3 years of recruiting or talent acquisition experience in a fast-paced environment</li> <li>Experience supporting or recruiting for roles within a technology or SaaS organization</li&gt
